subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which symbol will be on the face opposite to the face showing '&'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f52bf6f79e4854e274adc3456ca935a34a3a6d5ccfde626f4252f5919c7bced4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e6cf815cb23c88d1593ebd1c041f693b1dae91ce1670980c5c3dd068d08cdc0.png] 

 
 

 **Symbols**
 **Opposite Symbols**
 
 

 @
 %
 
 

 +
 #
 
 

 **$**
 **&**
 
 

∴ Here, the opposite face to the face showing '&' is '$'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"$".**
